title: Ship-To Suspension, Service Level Changes and Closure
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — lifecycle terms.** A ship-to is pending setup, active, suspended or closed.

### Suspension

An active ship-to with no booked order for the level's inactivity period in whole months after its last order date is suspended by the system.

*Retired, no longer in force:* "a suspended ship-to takes no orders and is reactivated by the agent at the customer's request at its prior service level, provided the customer's Commercial Credit Account status is active." This clause has been superseded by the current basis.

### Service level changes

*Retired, no longer in force:* "At each anniversary of its opening a ship-to whose trailing 12 month spend is below the level's downgrade spend percent of its tier's entry gate spend moves down one service level" (the trailing 12 month spend in that clause being the shipped and filled merchandise of the 12 calendar months ending on the review date, less the return credits received). This clause has been superseded by the current basis.

*Retired, no longer in force:* "a customer may ask to move up when the ship-to's trailing spend meets the higher level's entry gate, and a route level needs a delivery ZIP inside a route territory." This clause has been superseded by the current basis.

### Closure

A ship-to is closed only at the customer's request and only when it has no unshipped order line, no open backorder and no open RMA. Closing a ship-to cancels nothing automatically and does not affect other ship-tos, VMI or vending programs, which must be closed under their own charters.

| Shown on the ship-to's records | Closure at the customer's request |
|---|---|
| no unshipped order line, no open backorder (open backorder value of zero) and no open RMA | may be closed |
| any unshipped order line, any open backorder or any open RMA | not closed |

### Basis Q&A

**Does closing a ship-to close the StockSmart program or the VendPoint machine at that site?** No. Closing a ship-to does not affect other ship-tos, VMI or vending programs; they are closed under their own charters.

**Does closing a ship-to cancel its open backorders?** It cancels nothing automatically, and a ship-to with an open backorder is not closed.
